description: This Java class configures a RestClient bean with OAuth2 security features, including setting up request interceptors, client registration resolution, and principal resolution for OAuth2 authentication.

classes.name: RestClientConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class that provides a RestClient bean configured with OAuth2 security interceptors and resolvers.

methods.name: RestClientConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor that injects the base URL from application properties.

methods.name: restClient
methods.description: Creates and configures a RestClient bean with OAuth2 interceptors, including client registration and principal resolvers.

methods.name: clientRegistrationIdResolver
methods.description: Provides a default implementation for resolving client registration IDs, using request attributes.

methods.name: principalResolver
methods.description: Provides a default principal resolver that uses SecurityContextHolder.
